main.description: Metadata for an image uploaded into a namespace. The raw bytes are NOT embedded in this record -- they live at a sibling freeform key (no lexicon, network.essmesh.chat.image.blob/{rkey}) sharing this record's own rkey, written via namespace::put_bytes rather than a separate out-of-band blob-add API. That choice matters: iroh-docs already transfers a doc entry's content blob alongside its metadata as part of ordinary sync, the same mechanism every other record in this design relies on -- so an image needs no new sync primitive, no separate 'now go fetch this blob by hash from a peer' step. Splitting metadata from bytes keeps a gallery listing cheap: reading every ImageMeta in a namespace never means downloading every image in it.

contentType.description: e.g. 'image/png'. Not validated against a fixed list -- a reader that doesn't understand a given type can still show the caption and skip rendering.

len.description: Byte length of the image content at the sibling blob key.
